messages:
jess: Quick preflight — tenant 'redwood-data-prod' needs ND/NC quota bump in eastus2 for a burst test next week. Also need NSG port increases (tcp 1024-65535) for our kube node-to-node overlay. Can someone confirm the exact subscription and a rough ETA for quota? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

samir: Which subscription id are we talking about? I'm assuming the staging subscription, or is this prod?

jess: prod. subscription: sub-0a1b2c3d (linked in org). We're planning a short reserved capacity test: 8xND40rs + fallback to 4xNC for lower-priority jobs. Need quota for GPU SKUs and vCPUs in eastus2.

olivia: tagging for canary routing: if ND capacity isn't available we'll route non-critical batches to NC with quantized models. Make sure rollout policy is set to preserve latency SLOs.

samir: I'll open the support ticket now. Pre-check commands I ran locally: 
```
# check current usage in eastus2
az vm list-usage --location eastus2 | grep -i gpu
# check sku availability
az vm list-skus --location eastus2 --size Standard_ND* --output table
```
But ACL/NSG port range change will need a network owner approval and a service tag review.

jess: thanks. For NSG, we only need ephemeral high ports for the overlay (1024-65535) and health probes 10250,10255. Can infra open a change request with networking and include potential security mitigations?

infra-bot: change request created: CR-2026-0427-NET. Assigned: samir, status: pending review. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CR-2026-0427 :white_check_mark:

samir: Support ticket opened: AZURE-TKT-887211. I put the exact SKU and quota numbers: 8x Standard_ND40rs_v2, 4x Standard_NC24rs_v3, vCPU quota increase 512 -> 1024 for eastus2. Pasted our workload profile and intended start window 2026-04-30 02:00 UTC.

azure-support: Hello team — we've received AZURE-TKT-887211. Initial review: ND40rs availability in eastus2 is constrained this week. We can increase subscription quota but capacity reservation may take 3-7 business days to guarantee. Please provide business justification and expected monthly consume.

jess: Business justification posted in ticket: "performance benchmark for high-throughput LLM inference; burst test to validate autoscaling and fallback routing; expected consumption ~1.2M input tokens/day during test window." Mentioned support for compliant data on dedicated instances.

olivia: Cost note for PMs: short burst of 8 ND40rs for ~48 hours will be ~estimated $XXk, plus fallback NC usage. Recommend a small reserved capacity commitment if we plan recurring bursts.

samir: For temporary unblock, propose a phased approach: 1) Increase quota + transient allocation on approval, 2) Run smoke test with 2x ND and 2x NC, 3) If all good, request capacity reservation. I'll update AZURE-TKT-887211 with phased plan.

jess: Perfect. Also adding a quick smoke test snippet to the ticket: 
```
# spin up a small k8s pool with ND and NC for smoke 
kubectl apply -f smoke-nd-nc-pool.yaml
# run latency load script
./tools/latency-test --endpoint https://redwood-prod-eu/api/generate --concurrency 8 --duration 10m
```

azure-support: Noted. Please keep the ticket updated with smoke test results; capacity reservation request will be queued after justification and preflight checks.

olivia: tagging @security for NSG port range review. If they flag, we can use service tags + forced egress rules instead of wide port exposure.

jess: thanks everyone — I'll monitor the ticket and post updates here. Ping me if you need any additional payloads or logs. :rocket:
